entity_raw.definition_raw:
This animal’s charges move its enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Bull Rush, Power Attack, animal companion.

Benefit(s): Once per round when this animal companion hits an opponent with a charge attack, it can initiate a bull rush against that target as a free action. If it moves its full speed as part of the charge, it gains a +4 bonus on its combat maneuver check to resolve this bull rush.
